doc_header_footer.description: Add a header and/or footer to pages. Text boxes: header_left/center/right, footer_left/center/right. Tokens: <<1>> page number, <<n>> page count, <<1 of n>>, <<Page 1 of n>>, <<1/n>>, dates <<m/d/yyyy>> <<yyyy-mm-dd>> <<mmmm d, yyyy>> (and more), Bates <<Bates Number#6#1#PREFIX#SUFFIX>>. replace: true swaps out existing ones (Update). Undoable.
